cases.title: The Harrow Enigma
cases.subtitle: A Locked Room Mystery
cases.teaser: A real estate tycoon is found dead in his study, locked from the inside.
cases.description: Daniel Harrow was found dead. The gun was in his left hand, but he was right-handed. The door was locked from the inside using a hidden mechanism.
cases.solution_secret: Thomas used a thin fishing line found in the desk to pull the door shut and lock it from the hallway. He then "broke down the door" to hide the evidence of the line.

suspects.name: Thomas Harrow
suspects.description: The sole beneficiary of the new will.

cases.title: Vineyard Vendetta
cases.subtitle: The Poisoned Vintage
cases.teaser: The patriarch of the Rossi wine empire dies mid-toast.
cases.description: Lorenzo collapsed after drinking his private reserve. The bottle was sealed, and he was the one who opened it.
cases.solution_secret: Bianca poisoned the ice cubes in the bucket, not the wine itself. As the ice melted in his glass, the toxin was released.

suspects.name: Bianca Rossi
suspects.description: Wants to modernize the winery; Lorenzo refused.

clues.title: Tainted Ice
clues.description: Melted water in the bucket tested positive for hemlock.

cases.title: The Phantom of the Opera House
cases.subtitle: A Masked Murder
cases.teaser: A diva's final performance ends in tragedy backstage.
cases.description: Isabelle Moreau, the opera's star soprano, was found murdered in her dressing room. The door was bolted from the inside, and a single red rose lay on her vanity. There are rumors of a "Phantom" haunting the rafters.
cases.solution_secret: The "rival" baritone Lucian Vane used a secret stage trapdoor located behind the dressing room mirror—a mechanism used for quick costume changes—to enter and exit. He bolted the main door from the inside before leaving through the trapdoor and left the rose to stage the crime as the work of the legendary Phantom.

suspects.name: Lucian Vane
suspects.description: A talented singer who has lived in Isabelle's shadow for years.
suspects.motive: Professional jealousy; he believed he was destined for the lead role.
suspects.alibi: Claimed to be practicing in the basement rehearsal hall alone.

suspects.name: Monsieur Richard
suspects.description: Heavily in debt and desperate for a successful season.
suspects.motive: Insurance fraud; Isabelle's life was insured for a fortune.
suspects.alibi: In his office checking the night's receipts.

clues.title: The Red Rose
clues.description: A fresh cut rose, thorns removed. Traditionally left by the Phantom.

clues.title: Hinge Oil
clues.description: Trace amounts of industrial watch oil found on the floor near the mirror.

clues.title: Old Blueprints
clues.description: Blueprints showing forgotten service tunnels connecting the dressing rooms.

timeline.event: Isabelle finishes her second act aria.
Isabelle returns to her dressing room alone.
A muffled scream is heard by a stagehand.

cases.title: The Silicon Secret
cases.subtitle: High-Tech Sabotage
cases.teaser: A robotics CEO is electrocuted in a water-sealed server room.
cases.description: Dr. Thorne was found dead in the server room. The high-voltage floor tiles were activated remotely.
cases.solution_secret: Mira used a remote hacking device to spoof Aris's biometrics using a high-resolution 3D-printed glove and heat-sync technology.

suspects.name: Mira Chen
suspects.description: Brilliant but felt Thorne stole her patents.
suspects.alibi: Calibrating a robot in Lab B.

suspects.name: Jax Miller
suspects.description: Pressuring Thorne to sell to a defense contractor.

clues.title: Residue
clues.description: Glove residue found near the panel.

cases.title: The Alpine Alibi
cases.subtitle: Death at High Altitude
cases.teaser: A champion skier is found dead at the bottom of a ravine.
cases.description: Sven fell 500 feet. The safety cable was sliced clean during a blizzard.
cases.solution_secret: Katarina used a high-powered drone equipped with a heated ceramic blade to cut the cable from the lodge balcony.

suspects.name: Katarina Volkov
suspects.description: Blamed Sven for her failed career.

cases.title: The Midnight Gallery
cases.subtitle: The Stolen Masterpiece
cases.teaser: A priceless Vermeer vanishes. The guard is dead.
cases.description: Officer Reed was killed by a blunt object. The painting "The Girl in the Window" is gone.
cases.solution_secret: Julian used a replica painting to swap the real one. Marcus caught him, and Julian struck him with a heavy bronze pedestal.

suspects.name: Sophia Sterling
suspects.description: Under pressure to save the failing museum.

cases.title: The Obsidian Orchid
cases.subtitle: A Noir Nightmare
cases.teaser: A private eye is killed in his own office with a weapon he never used.
cases.description: Spade was killed by a .38 caliber bullet. His own gun was a .45. The office was locked from the outside.
cases.solution_secret: Lila hid in the shadows of the coat rack, shot him, then slipped out through the transom window which only she knew didn't lock.

clues.title: Open Window
clues.description: Smudges found on the ceiling transom.
